style_en: Japanese TV anime style, crisp clean line art, cel shading, calm colors, bright even light. Pure white background.
avoid_en: 文字、ロゴ、現代の建物や服、大陸風（中国風）の服、裸、血

irogu.desc_en: Hata no Irogu, a wealthy landowner of ancient Yamashiro in Japan, a proud man about 40 years old with a short black beard, black hair tied in mizura loops beside both ears, a white Kofun-period kinu tunic with a brown sash and white hakama trousers tied below the knees, a simple wooden longbow, no armor

ukanomitama.desc_en: Ukanomitama, a gentle goddess of rice and grain of ancient Japan in her early 20s, long black hair tied low at the back, a white Kofun-period kinu robe with a pale gold sash, a green magatama bead necklace, holding a bundle of golden rice ears, calm kind face
